authorInfo.bio: Samuel Taylor Coleridge  was an English poet, literary critic, philosopher, and theologian who was a founder of the Romantic Movement in England and a member of the Lake Poets with his friend William Wordsworth. He also shared volumes and collaborated with Charles Lamb, Robert Southey, and Charles Lloyd.

sourceTitle: Hints towards the formation of a more comprehensive theory of life.
description: "Hints towards the formation of a more comprehensive theory of life" by Samuel Taylor Coleridge is a philosophical work published in 1818. Coleridge challenges Enlightenment science's mechanistic view of nature, seeking to understand life as more than mere matter in motion.
